key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep running after the window is closed
key.description: So that newly inserted devices are still announced. With a tray, the icon reopens the window; without one, launching the application again does.

key.name: notify-inserted
key.summary: Notify when an unauthorized device is inserted

key.name: default-persistence
key.description: Runtime-only by default: for a security tool, the less destructive choice is the one whose effect disappears on restart.

key.name: show-blocked-only
key.summary: Device list filter: show only unauthorized devices

key.name: tray-notice-shown
key.summary: Whether the one-time notice about tray availability was shown
